name: MANIFESTUM Mão Morta Redux e Pedro Serrazina
description: The Mão Morta Redux trio performs a film-concert that combines their music with three films by Pedro Serrazina. The event includes a conversation with the artists, moderated by journalist Ricardo Alexandre.
longDescription:
The Mão Morta Redux trio, featuring Adolfo Luxúria Canibal, Miguel Pedro, and António Rafael, presents a film-concert. This performance merges their musical identity with three films by Pedro Serrazina, creating a unique audiovisual experience.

The event takes place on November 20, 2026, at 21:30, at Fórum Cult. de Ermesinde in Porto. Doors open at 21:05. The show has a duration of 90 minutes and no interval. Tickets are priced at 5€.

Before the film-concert, there will be a conversation with the artists, moderated by journalist Ricardo Alexandre. The event is recommended for ages 12 and up.
